summary: Implemented truthful health completeness and supported dependency-audit parsing. Required missing, skipped, disabled, filtered, execution-failed and parse-failed evidence yields INCOMPLETE unless blocking findings or regression thresholds produce FAIL; coverage remains independently incomplete. Bun and npm audit formats preserve advisory identity, unknown/malformed JSON cannot pass, recognized findings survive nonzero exits, and CLI/service/report behavior agrees. Root typecheck awaits the coordinated outside-owned harness gate-union propagation and concurrent containment work.
